text: In nineteen fifty-seven, America may have launched a manhole cover faster than any rocket ever built. Test Pascal-B put a small nuclear device at the bottom of a hundred and fifty metre shaft, capped with a nine hundred kilo steel lid. The blast turned the shaft into a gun barrel. Superheated gas slammed into the lid from below. A high-speed camera caught it in a single frame. The estimate: about sixty-six kilometres per second. Six times Earth's escape velocity. It was never found. It probably burned up in the air. Dave was sitting on it for luck.
